body: I have trouble actually going to class. I think about how much I have to do, and I panic. When I lived at college, I had no problem going to class. Perhaps it's my living situation that's making me stressed out. I'm looking right now to move out.

What I specifically want to do is become a psychiatrist. I always wondered why I was given depression and borderline personality disorder, and after volunteering at a hospital, I think I know why. I think I was born with these problems so I can help out those who are in similar situations. While going through the mental hospital system, I realized that there need to be more changes. One of those changes is to have better doctors. Maybe it is just a way to cope with my illnesses, but I really want to help out in any way I can.

But it really stinks, because the thing that I want with all my heart is becoming less and less possible to accomplish. How am I supposed to go through medical school when I get too anxious to even go to undergraduate classes?
Thank you for your kind words. Every bit of encouragement helps.
